notes.title: Recent changes
notes.notes:
Dear community,
[url=http://www.displacementstudios.com]Displacement Studios[/url] acquired [i]The Spirit Underneath[/i] and performed the following changes:
[list]
[*] decreased the price to $0.99
[*] removed a not required redistributable
[*] adjusted the store page and the minimum/recommended hardware specifications
[*] enabled the Steam Cloud synchronization for savegames
[*] disabled a disimproving framerate optimization feature
[*] fixed an issue which does not count any playtime without the use of external software
[*] added automatic in-game healing when the player gets wounded

notes.title: Added models, optimization and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Today we uploaded a smaller sized update, although still with improvements and new content. We have added a few new models, including new ai and weapon models. We have also worked on optimizing the game a bit more, as well as some minor bug fixes, and a bug that did not allow few players to continue a save.

~ Acuze Team

notes.title: Official Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
The release date for The Spirit Underneath has officially been set to [b]January 3rd![/b] The release date is moved into the new year as we are interested in a 2017 release rather than a 2016. 

In the mean time beta testing is still going on and if you wish to participate you can leave a comment here or email us at [b]contact@acuzeenterprise.com[/b]

Merry christmas,
Acuze team. 

[h1]EDIT/UPDATE:[/h1]
[b]Thanks to everyone who has shown their interest! Our beta spots have now been fulfilled and we are no longer looking for any beta testers at the moment. For those who have been accepted the last day, we will be distributing the keys to you via email/ Steam tomorrow (December 26th), and once the beta is finished the game will than be revoked from your library. Thanks again everyone![/b]
